name: gizza-ai/video-to-gif
summary: Convert a section of a video into an optimized animated GIF

tool.description: Convert a section of a video into an optimized animated GIF. Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). Optional start, duration, fps, and width. Output is a looping GIF made with a per-clip palette for high quality at a small size.

url.description: Video URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

start.description: Start time in seconds (default 0, from the beginning).

duration.description: Clip length in seconds (default 0 = to the end of the video).

fps.description: Frames per second of the GIF (default 12). Lower fps = smaller file.

width.description: Output width in pixels; height scales to keep aspect ratio (default 0 = keep source size).
